VERDICT: Do not arm anything. The single highest-leverage move is offline daily recalibration (EMOS) on the existing forecast-vs-obs archive — no new data, no settlements needed — then gate all daily trades on post-calibration edge after fees. Hourly is confirmed dead (cal good, edge negative after fees); treat it as monitor-only, zero capital.

REASONING: The 31%-win-vs-64%-pred gap on daily NO means the "paper edge" is a calibration artifact: the model over-predicts high-bucket probability (under-calls highs/extremes), so NO fills look cheap but lose. Calibration error lives in the tail exactly where the trades are, so no sizing or selection trick can rescue it. Because you archive prevruns + truth, this is fixable offline today. Hourly has honest calibration (0.02) but structurally negative edge after fees — that's a fee/price problem, not a model problem, and EMOS won't create alpha there.
